name: Triparty Collateral Status Advice V 01
definition: Scope:|This message is sent by a triparty agent after the receipt of a collateral instruction from its client.||In this message, the Sender is the triparty agent and the Receiver is either the collateral taker or the collateral giver or their account servicer.||Usage:|This message provides valuation results as well as the status of the  proposed collateral movements (cash and securities).

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message and continuation indicator to indicate that the multi-part preliminary advice is to continue or that the message is the last page of the multi-part preliminary advice.

AllocationStatus.name: Allocation Status
AllocationStatus.definition: Provides the status of allocation of collateral to cover the instruction.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Provides the status of settlement of the transaction or the instruction.

CollateralStatus.name: Collateral Status
CollateralStatus.definition: Provides the collateral status of an instruction.

GeneralParameters.name: General Parameters
GeneralParameters.definition: provides general information about the instruction and collateral transaction the message refers to.

CollateralParties.name: Collateral Parties
CollateralParties.definition: Identifies the chain of collateral parties.

DealTransactionDetails.name: Deal Transaction Details
DealTransactionDetails.definition: Specifies the information related to the deal.

DealTransactionDate.name: Deal Transaction Date
DealTransactionDate.definition: Identifies the dates related to the triparty collateral instruction or transactions.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

SettlementStatusPresenceRule.definition: If settlement status is absent then allocation status or collateral status must be present.

CollateralStatusPresenceRule.definition: If collateral status is absent then allocation status or settlement status must be present.

AllocationStatusPresenceRule.definition: If allocation status is absent then settlement status or collateral status must be present.
